en.t: That would only make me uneasy.

units.source_text: 这是同她开玩笑，并非真个疑心花散里有外情。

en.t: He was joking with her, and did not truly suspect Hanachirusato of having another lover.

units.source_text: 她这几年来独守空闺，静候公子驾返，

en.t: For these past few years she had lived alone in her empty chamber, quietly waiting for the prince to return,

units.source_text: 其坚贞之操，源氏公子决不轻视。

en.t: and Prince Genji certainly did not take her faithful constancy lightly.

units.source_text: 她说起前年临别时公子吟“后日终当重见月，云天暂暗不须忧”之句，

en.t: She spoke of the poem he had recited when they parted the year before last, saying that one day they would surely see the moon again and need not grieve over clouds that only darkened the sky for a while,

units.source_text: 约她誓必重逢时的情状。

en.t: and recalled how he had promised her that they would certainly meet again.

units.source_text: 接着又说：“其实那时惜别何必如此悲伤？

en.t: Then she went on, In truth, why did we need to grieve so much over parting then?

units.source_text: 你重返京城也不来看我，

en.t: Even after you returned to the capital, you did not come to see me,

units.source_text: 反正我这薄命之身，现在还是一样悲伤。”

en.t: so this ill-fated self of mine is just as sorrowful now as ever.

units.source_text: 说时娇嗔之相甚是可爱。

en.t: As she said this, her sweetly reproachful expression was very charming.

units.source_text: 源氏公子照例用一大套甜言蜜语来安慰她，

en.t: Prince Genji, as usual, comforted her with a great stream of honeyed words,

units.source_text: 这些话不知道他是从哪里学来的。

en.t: though no one knew where he had learned such things to say.
